results.title: Bandits kill Chinese, Police Inspector in Bauchi, abduct nine in Kaduna - The Nation Newspaper
results.snippet:
The victims were identified as Wang Tingjian, the Chinese expatriate, and Inspector Yau Abba, of the Mobile Police Force, MOPOL 34.

The attack happened last Saturday, at Ruga Village in Gwana District, where Tingjian was  involved in core drilling during a survey of a mining site.A

Also, suspected bandits have abducted nine residents of Kurmin Wali community in Afogo Ward, Kajuru Local Governmen
